purpose: Teach: コピペ/うんこ/メイル/クリエーター/できよ/チョー/シャラ/コットン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宿題でコピペしてバレたな
lines.en: Riku, I caught you copying your homework and getting busted for it.
lines.style: Wry, teasing lilt on the accusation. Quick tempo, like she's got dirt and is enjoying holding it. Slight smirk underneath the words.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、低学年の頃「うんこ」連発してたよな、桜
lines.en: You were saying 'unko' every other sentence in elementary school, Sakura.
lines.style: Deadpan counter-strike. Lean into the absurdity. Measured pace with a tiny pause before her name — letting her know he remembers too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、先生にメイル、つまりメール送ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were sending emails to the teacher — actual emails.
lines.style: Amused disbelief. The word 'emails' lands with a tiny laugh underneath. Eyebrow raised, genuinely curious how he justified it to himself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で「クリエーター」を自称してたな、桜
lines.en: You called yourself a 'Creator' at the cultural festival, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat delivery with quiet amusement in the subtext. The air quotes are in his tone, not his hands. Her name at the end lands gentle, almost fond.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、給食で「お代わりできよ」って古風に言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you asked for seconds at lunch using that old-fashioned phrasing 'dekiyo.'
lines.style: Bright catch, like she's delighted by how dated it sounds. Quick energy, playful mockery. The word 'dekiyo' gets a tiny arch to it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、最近「チョー」連発してるな、桜
lines.en: You've been throwing around 'chou' left and right lately, Sakura.
lines.style: Observant, slightly exasperated but warm. Like he's been noticing this for a while. Measured pace, matter-of-fact tone that betrays he finds it endearing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テニス部でシャラポワのフォーム真似してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were copying Sharapova's form during tennis club.
lines.style: Curious amusement. The recognition lands with a slight smile in the voice. Wondering aloud, like she's genuinely impressed by the specificity of his admiration.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、制服の下にコットンのTシャツ重ね着してたな、桜
lines.en: You used to layer a cotton t-shirt under your uniform, Sakura.
lines.style: Close observation, almost affectionate. Quiet, intimate tone — the kind of thing only someone who actually watches notices. Small smile, no mockery.
